'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jarad Konsker DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jarad Konsker]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jarad K
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
